## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Frontend lint, type-check, tests, and build pass.
- [ ] Backend lint, formatting, type-check, and tests pass.
- [ ] Added or updated tests for changed behavior.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and `main` remains runnable.
- [ ] No secrets or generated dependencies are committed.
- [ ] Documentation and `docs/decisions.md` are updated if needed.
- [ ] Any known limitation or follow-up is stated above.
